title: bug: session retention can delete unrelated sessions on short-ID collision

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear, detailed, and reproducible bug report identifying session data loss during session retention cleanup when unrelated sessions share an 8-character short ID suffix. It details the exact bug location in packages/cli/src/utils/sessionCleanup.ts, reproduction steps, expected behavior, and root cause.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The bug fix is localized to a single file (packages/cli/src/utils/sessionCleanup.ts) and its unit test (packages/cli/src/utils/sessionCleanup.test.ts). Fix involves checking full session ID / parent session relationships for matching files rather than indiscriminately deleting all files matching an 8-character short ID suffix.

summary.problem: Session retention cleanup can delete active or non-expired sessions if their filenames happen to share the same 8-character short ID suffix as an expired session.
summary.root_cause: When a session is marked for deletion in cleanupExpiredSessions(), the cleanup logic extracts an 8-character short ID suffix from the filename and deletes all session files matching -${shortId}.json or -${shortId}.jsonl without verifying whether each matched file belongs to the expired session family or independently satisfies retention criteria.
summary.context: Session files use 8-character hexadecimal suffixes in filenames. If an unrelated recent session has a UUID whose first 8 characters match an expired session's short ID, sessionCleanup.ts unlinks both files and deletes their associated artifacts.

steps: Update the deletion matching logic in cleanupExpiredSessions() within packages/cli/src/utils/sessionCleanup.ts to inspect the full session ID and parent session relationships of candidate files before deleting them.
Ensure that files sharing a short ID suffix are only deleted if their full session ID matches the expired session or if they are verified subagent sessions belonging to the expired session.
Prevent unrelated non-expired sessions from being deleted when a short ID collision occurs.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Only expired sessions and their associated subagents are deleted during cleanup. Unrelated active or non-expired sessions sharing the same short ID suffix remain intact.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in packages/cli/src/utils/sessionCleanup.test.ts featuring an expired session and an unrelated recent session sharing the same 8-character filename suffix.
Run cleanupExpiredSessions() and verify that the expired session is deleted while the recent session and its artifacts survive.
